notes: Titles only (all rights reserved). Unit, module and lesson titles of the Into Algebra 1, Into Geometry and Into Algebra 2 courses as listed on IXL's public skill-plan pages (one per course, cited as each unit's url; robots.txt allows /math/skill-plans/, no login). Only the textbook's own numbers and titles are kept, not IXL's skill names. IXL lists the lessons it aligns skills to, so a lesson with no IXL skill may be missing. Math typeset in a title is written plainly (x², nth). Algebra 1 → grade 9, Geometry → 10, Algebra 2 → 11. Modules are numbered through the course; Algebra 1 and 2 lessons restart at 1 in each module, Geometry lessons are numbered module.lesson as IXL lists them. Skills are mapped per module; a unit's skills are the union.
